mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park under a first quarter moon, and unfortunately no ISS sightings are visible tonight.

The City of Verona keeps residents informed through the VHAT cable channel and digital newsletters, while also reminding residents that residential vehicle storage requires specific designated surfaces and screening.
There is plenty to do today including Yoga at Insight Wellness and the Concerts in the Park series, followed by live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard happening tomorrow.
In a noteworthy incident from July 13th, a Madison man was arrested for an O-W-I after officers responded to a vehicle stuck on a large rock.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Really Reese's. The store is currently closed but will open at 10:00 AM today.
